citation.authors: Tripolt NJ, Hofer SJ, Pferschy PN, Aziz F, Durand S, et al.
citation.title: Glucose Metabolism and Metabolomic Changes in Response to Prolonged Fasting in Individuals with Obesity, Type 2 Diabetes and Non-Obese People—A Cohort Trial

population.description: Non-obese cohort of 20 (BMI 20-27 kg/m2, fasting glucose < 110 mg/dL, no diabetes, cardiovascular disease or glucose/lipid/BP-lowering drugs; called healthy non-obese). Age and BMI from Table 1. Sex is not printed per cohort (62% women over all 60 participants), so mixed. The obese cohort (n = 20, BMI > 30, fasting glucose < 110 mg/dL, not screened by an OGTT) is entered as unselected on its arms, with Table 1 age 37 +/- 10 y and BMI 34.6 +/- 4.8. The type 2 diabetes cohort is not entered.

protocols.name: healthy_f12_fasting
protocols.description: Non-obese healthy cohort: fasting sample after the 12 h fast (calorie-free drinks only; last meal 20:00 the evening before, printed as '12 h'). Arm starts at the visit start, 7:30, so prefast_hours = 11.5 (20:00 to 7:30); the fasting blood sample came after the physical examination and its clock time is not printed, so it is read at minutes 29-30 (about 8:00, 12.0 h after the last meal). Arm length not printed; short run-in.

protocols.name: healthy_f36_fasting
protocols.description: Non-obese healthy cohort: fasting sample after the 36 h fast (calorie-free drinks only; last meal 20:00 two days before, printed as '36 h'). Arm starts at the visit start, 7:30, so prefast_hours = 35.5 (20:00 to 7:30, two days earlier, 35 h 30 min); the fasting blood sample came after the physical examination and its clock time is not printed, so it is read at minutes 29-30 (about 8:00, 36.0 h after the last meal). Arm length not printed; short run-in.

protocols.name: healthy_f12_ogtt
protocols.description: Non-obese healthy cohort: 75 g glucose solution (Glucoral 75 citron) drunk within 2-4 min at minute 0 (printed) after the 12 h fast (last meal 20:00 the evening before); samples through 120 min. Visits began 7:30 with an examination, then the fasting sample (-5 min) and the drink; the clock hour of the drink is not printed, so start_hour 8.0 is assumed, and prefast_hours = 12 is 20:00 to that assumed 8:00 (12 h, as printed).

left_out.what: Type 2 diabetes cohort (n = 20, age 60 +/- 9 y, on oral glucose-lowering drugs): all values, Table 2 and text
Fasting insulin at 12 h and 36 h for the non-obese and obese cohorts, fasting C-peptide and proinsulin, QUICKI, HOMA-IR, ISI, HOMA-beta (Table 2; printed as median (IQR))
Fasting C-peptide (ng/mL), all cohorts, Table 2 and text
QUICKI, HOMA-IR, Matsuda ISI, Stumvoll 1st and 2nd phase insulin secretion, HOMA-beta, delta-Ins30/delta-Glc30 (Table 2) are derived indices
Glucose AUC and insulin AUC over the OGTT (Table 2, 'in minutes'): the OGTT sampling minutes are not printed (only the -5 min and 120 min samples are named)
Glucose and insulin time courses of the OGTT in each cohort (Figure 1) and of the IVGTT sub-study (n = 10 per cohort, Figures S1 and S2); insulin at 30 min of the obese cohort is not printed
Baseline characteristics (Table 1: blood pressure, waist-to-hip ratio, HbA1c; age, BMI and weight are entered as population): the table does not say whether it is the 12 h or the 36 h visit
Serum metabolomics (195 metabolites, ketone bodies among them) at 12 h and 36 h: fold changes shown in figures and supplementary tables only
